name: Video Wallpaper Manager
author: p3lusa
description: Video-wallpaper manager for Omarchy, built on the OWE wallpaper engine (owed): every clip is paired with its own theme, so video, palette, and wallpaper always change together. Full library TUI (browse, preview, add, remove, re-extract palette), instant prev/next cycle hotkeys, and per-clip themes that are created and reaped automatically. Rendering, hardware decode (VAAPI), pause policies (lock/idle/fullscreen/DPMS/battery), and GIF handling come from owe — install it with 'omarchy pkg add owe'. Pairs with the companion video-wallpaper theme (p3lusa/video-wallpaper), which ships the clip library; the theme alone only shows static images.
